subject: How to calculate proportion of the variance of trait explained by  each locus?

messages.author: 8d2cb471019871f2
messages.subject: How to calculate proportion of the variance of trait explained by  each locus?
parts:
Hello,

I was wondering if R/QTL does calculate the proportion of the variance
of trait explained by each locus..

To make the question more clear, I pasted some examples from papers,

"...eQTL with LOD scores greater than 4.3 explained 25% of the
transcription variation of the corresponding genes.."

or

"...the locus on chr 5 showed highly significant linkage to the
disease, accounting for 15% of the variance in the disease..."

Thanks!
Murim

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] How to calculate proportion of the variance of trait explained by  each locus?
parts:
You can use fitqtl to get estimated percent phenotypic variance
explained.

karl
